baseline: Previously qualified release benchmark from seven-priorities-2026-10-24.json; matching SHA-256 verified.
fixes: Use complete typed bindings instead of expanded debug SQL, which truncates NUL text and can collide across distinct searches.
Keep count, effective page size and stale-offset recovery inside one snapshot for both navigation paths.
Do not prepare cached COUNT queries or hydrate metadata for out-of-range pages; copy cursor hints without cloning stored key strings.
regressions: Reproduced before the fix: tag:systems returned 25 matches; tag:systems\u0000different incorrectly reused 25 although a cold read returned zero. The corrected cached read returns zero.
450 scope/filter/offset comparisons verify full article metadata against cold reads across both directions and ranked/grouped fallbacks.
External deletion during tail refill keeps the earlier count and page snapshot; the next read sees the committed deletion.
Zero, oversized and maximal offsets/limits, anchor jumps, empty libraries, retained Inbox rows, local/external changes and rollback are covered.
SQLite authorizer guards prove cached counts and impossible-page metadata are not prepared.

method.profile: release; thin LTO; one codegen unit; build jobs 2
method.ordering: Alternating before/after processes, reversed middle pair; no builds or other tests during measurements.
method.warmness: Setup precedes timing. The first cached iteration includes the initial OFFSET jump; later iterations reuse page hints. No writes occur during the timed loop.
method.verification: Final harness checks every article identity, page length and total; the previously qualified baseline checked the first identity, length and total.
limits: Single-machine controlled fixtures are not application-wide latency guarantees.
Observed cached-page medians were essentially unchanged; no further speedup is claimed.
Database version invalidation remains conservative across unrelated commits.
